kartdata: Client for Norwegian Mapping Authority Topographic Data

Source: R/kartdata-package.R
kartdata-package.Rd

Discover and download topographic N-series data directly from Geonorge using official ATOM feeds. Cache original archives locally and read individual spatial layers with 'sf'. No map data are distributed.
